name: La Faille
source:
A group of teenagers on a school trip will have to face the mysterious disappearance of one of their classmates… Take part in this adventure at the edge of reality, featuring a perilous orienteering race, strange ruins, and a cascade of revelations!

[Translated from [url=https://chesterr.itch.io/la-faille]Itch.io[/url]]
